why: rungs ad_voice_placeholder / voice_types: an ad narrator says its own name inside a pre-roll sponsor read; the cleaning step marks the voice an ad and it is never named. The read needs the markers a real one carries (sponsor, URL, promo code, terms): the pre-roll detector requires 3 ad-pattern hits (ad_regions.PREROLL_THRESHOLD), and a one-line 'sponsored by' read is not detected as an ad at all. And the episode must be real length: the edge-ad rule types a voice an ad only below 3% of the talk (AD_VOICE_MAX_SHARE) in an episode of 600 s or more; a 25 s read in a 12-minute episode is 3.4% and stays a named 'person' (a non-edge commercial voice keeps a self-introduced name: roster voice typing checks `named` before `commercial`). Prod measurement: 0 named voices >=90% inside detected ads (2,606 episodes, 2026-10-11).
